title: Search discoverability
description: Audit technical/content SEO, implement requested bounded fixes, and verify actual outputs and available search evidence.
intent: Complete the requested SEO audit or scoped remediation. Search metrics require actual sources; selecting this team does not authorize publication, account writes, outreach, or paid tooling.

assignments.task: Establish scope and inspect technical eligibility, site structure, intent/content, structured data, and available search measurements.
Gather current authoritative search/platform references or bounded competitor evidence.
assignments.when: Current or niche facts need verification.

assignments.task: Return requested metadata/content drafts aligned with actual page behavior and intent.
Assess available page-performance measurements without speculative tuning.
assignments.when: Performance evidence is relevant to the requested audit or fix.

assignments.task: Assess specified locale content, language routing, and translation consistency.
Assess shared discovery foundations and available AI representation evidence.
assignments.when: AI-answer visibility is also explicitly in scope.

assignments.task: Implement only requested source/content SEO changes, preserving intentional privacy/indexing boundaries and user edits.
assignments.when: The user requests implementation or remediation.

assignments.task: Recheck completed findings or changed outputs, directives, canonicals, links, markup, and measurement limitations.
Check changed routes/content/rendering for actual regressions.
assignments.when: Implementation changed product source or executable behavior.

assignments.task: Check material numerical claims, supported content/markup, and claimed outcomes.
assignments.when: The final deliverable includes consequential quantitative or factual claims.

completion: Findings and requested fixes are scoped and evidence-linked, with intentional private/noindex boundaries preserved.
Changed outputs are checked after writing; crawl/index/rank outcomes are not inferred from source checks.
Actual search metrics and unavailable data remain distinct; publication and account actions are not implied.
